summary: Iteration 2 validated the 4 new features from the Capability Statement rollout. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (root, auth, contacts + Emergent email proxy 202, newsletter + duplicate handling, blog CRUD). Frontend: (1) PDF hosted at /assets/Lotus-USA-Capability-Statement.pdf returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/pdf (~914KB). All 3 download buttons (download-capability-home, download-capability-about, download-capability-contact) present and correctly point to that URL. (2) NAICS section on About page renders 19 codes by default; searching '541512' filters to 1 result, 'consulting' filters to 3 (all consulting-related), gibberish 'zzzzzzzzz999' shows the naics-empty state. (3) Trusted By section on Home renders and contains 'Department of Defense', 'NASA', 'LADWP', 'Internal Revenue Service' as text cards. (4) Contact + Newsletter submissions trigger Emergent email proxy — backend logs confirm 'POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send "HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted"' for both flows. Regression: 2,300+ text and UEI JBKGG25MLPM9 still present on Home; admin login (admin@lotususainc.com / LotusAdmin2026!) reaches /admin dashboard with all tabs (Leads/Subscribers/Blog).
critical_code_review_comments: NaicsSearch filter compares raw lowercased term against code (only digits); safe but term.trim().toLowerCase() on a numeric code has no effect — kept for uniformity, fine.
send_lead_email / send_newsletter_email silently return when EMAIL_KEY empty; consider logging a warning in that branch for observability (non-blocking).
PDF is served from frontend/public/assets — good, cache-control: no-store from ingress means every download hits origin; consider allowing caching for the static PDF later.
seed_data_creation: Test leads (TEST_John Doe, TEST_EmailProbe) and newsletter subscribers via backend_test.py; TEST_ contact deleted at end of run, one TEST_EmailProbe lead visible in admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover all endpoints including email proxy log verification. Frontend data-testids used this iteration: trusted-by, naics-section, naics-search-input, naics-results, naics-empty, download-capability-home/about/contact, newsletter-email/submit. Admin login button is not [type=submit] wrapper-selectable — use get_by_role('button', name='Sign In'). Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' — networkidle hangs due to persistent animations.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 4 iteration goals fully met.
